Private reflection you can correct before exploring peer experiences.
Planned Muse Spark may organize themes to review, never decide what is true.

He changes the words: it is his parents, and he wants time.
Now the editable reflection changes with what he said.
He wants time to decide, without advice to stay or leave.
Day four: one member wants time to choose.
Day nine. The host says, I can listen; I can’t decide for you.

Private conversation and context are excluded.
Consent is unchecked. Continue stays disabled.
